note: Agent-proposed bounded WP3C envelope; see docs/workstreams/wp3c-capability-linking-v1alpha4.md. Frozen Harness profile still lists WP3C as maintainer-queued; this inventory records the executed fixtures for Draft PR review.

fixtures.title: Positive trusted CapabilityContracts link
fixtures.input: Appendix E.4 CapabilityContracts bundle plus a trusted deployment authorization binding the same deploymentId and publisherId; Contract grants example.registration-read.
assertions: No WP3C diagnostic is emitted.
The Skill Grant, Capability definition and exact callable membership are parsed and retained.
Later unimplemented stages still fail closed; Build is not expected to succeed.
Bundle file order does not change capability indexing or diagnostics.

fixtures.title: Skill grants no Capability for the referenced callable
fixtures.input: Set Contract.capabilities to an empty list while the referenced callable membership remains valid.
assertions: Exactly one CAPABILITY_NOT_GRANTED/C_STATIC is emitted.
The diagnostic uses empty path and zero line/column.
A Capability definition alone is not treated as a Skill Grant.

fixtures.title: Deployment member Effect conflicts with ToolCatalog
fixtures.input: Change the matching capability member Effect from READ to MUTATION while the trusted ToolCatalog callable keeps Effect READ.
assertions: Exactly one EFFECT_MISMATCH/C_STATIC is emitted.
Effect describes the callable itself; the Skill Grant does not override it.
The diagnostic uses empty path and zero line/column.

fixtures.title: Referenced callable has no Capability member record
fixtures.input: Change the capability member owner so no record matches the trusted callable (owner, id, kind) identity.
assertions: Exactly one CAPABILITY_MAPPING_MISSING/C_STATIC is emitted.
Membership is matched by exact Owner + callable ID + kind, never by name similarity.
The diagnostic uses empty path and zero line/column.

fixtures.title: Referenced callable without trusted deployment input
fixtures.input: Keep the referenced callable and the valid dependency snapshots but omit trustedBuildContext.capabilityContracts.
assertions: Exactly one CAPABILITY_INPUT_UNTRUSTED/C_STATIC is emitted.
A Skill Grant and an ordinary DependencySnapshot are not accepted as deployment authorization.
Build remains failure-atomic.

fixtures.title: Deployment authorization does not bind the supplied deployment
fixtures.input: Supply a syntactically valid deployment authorization whose deploymentId differs from the CapabilityContracts bundle deploymentId.
assertions: Exactly one CAPABILITY_INPUT_UNTRUSTED/C_STATIC is emitted.
The authorizationRef is not dereferenced or trusted as proof.
Build remains failure-atomic.

fixtures.title: Capability ID defined more than once in the artifact set
fixtures.input: Add a second trusted CapabilityContracts file defining the same Capability ID example.registration-read.
assertions: Exactly one CAPABILITY_DEFINITION_CONFLICT/C_STATIC is emitted.
The first definition is retained; the duplicate is not merged.
The diagnostic uses empty path and zero line/column.

fixtures.title: Same member declared twice inside one Capability
fixtures.input: Duplicate the exact (owner, id, kind) member record inside the granted Capability.
assertions: Exactly one CAPABILITY_MEMBERSHIP_DUPLICATE/C_STATIC is emitted.
Duplicate membership is not silently collapsed or first-match selected.
Consistent membership across different Capabilities remains legal (see WP3C-010).

fixtures.title: Granted member has no trusted resolvable Scope policy reference
fixtures.input: Remove scopePolicyRef from the matching granted capability member.
assertions: Exactly one CAPABILITY_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED/C_STATIC is emitted.
Missing Scope is never interpreted as allow-all.
No Scope policy document format is invented to 'resolve' the reference.

fixtures.title: Ungranted member still participates in Effect consistency
fixtures.input: Add an ungranted Capability member for the same callable identity with a conflicting Effect; keep the granted member consistent.
assertions: Exactly one EFFECT_MISMATCH/C_STATIC is emitted.
Ungranted members are checked for Effect conflicts, catching identity conflicts before authorization changes.
The matching granted Capability keeps the callable authorized, so no CAPABILITY_NOT_GRANTED is emitted.

fixtures.title: Invalid CapabilityId in the Skill Grant list
fixtures.input: Add an invalid CapabilityId entry to Contract.capabilities while keeping the valid Grant.
assertions: Exactly one IDENTIFIER_INVALID/C_STATIC is emitted.
The diagnostic retains the original Contract YAML path/line/column.
The valid Grant is still processed.
